correctness.rationale: Strong law on independent parity subsequences gives the exact iid adjacent-transition rate. Algebraic b>3a forces positive curvature for a feasible four-point alternating exchange, forbidding supports ≥4. Every three-point support is one of two distance patterns; solving the single strictly concave type-A expression yields all five exact optima and a positive margin over any two-point/type-B competitor. Trace and doubled-angle geometry independently establishes one-step reversal. 10,829 finite checker assertions corroborate calculations but do not substitute for this universal proof.

value.rationale: The regular pentagonal five-direction tight frame is a natural canonical overcomplete planar row system; the sharp design requires exactly three nonuniform active rows, with full equality-case classification and exact advantage over all two-row or uniform schemes. The strict conflict with the tight-frame one-step MSE optimum gives mathematically meaningful guidance about selecting convergence objectives, and the proof explicitly addresses the nonconcavity left open by the general known quadratic formula.
